_comment: Cover art direction packs. These extend (and override) the interior packs in the qwen-kids-art skill's assets/style_packs.json. A cover is not an interior illustration: it has one hero subject, a silhouette that survives an 80px thumbnail, and deliberate empty space where type will be set. The signature is pasted verbatim so every book in a series matches. 'negative' is a starter negative-prompt list per pack - it only does anything on the 'full' runtime tier (real CFG); Qwen-Image's negative channel is inert at 'lightning' (CFG forced to 1.0). This file previously targeted FLUX.2 [klein], which had no working negative prompt at all.

early-reader-6-8.label: early reader
early-reader-6-8.detail_phrase: simple bold shapes with a few playful details and generous clear space
early-reader-6-8.buyer: a parent or grandparent scanning a grid of thumbnails on a phone

middle-grade-9-12.label: middle grade
middle-grade-9-12.detail_phrase: clear shapes with richer decorative detail and a sense of adventure
middle-grade-9-12.energy: adventurous and slightly aspirational, never babyish
middle-grade-9-12.buyer: a parent buying for a child who insists on choosing themselves

teen-13-17.label: teen
teen-13-17.detail_phrase: confident graphic composition with strong negative space
teen-13-17.energy: cool, designed, closer to adult non-fiction than to children's art
teen-13-17.buyer: the teen themselves, or a parent who wants the teen to actually open it

adult-general.label: adult
adult-general.detail_phrase: restrained composition with a single clear focal idea
adult-general.buyer: a browser deciding in under two seconds whether this looks professionally published

kids_activity_bold.description: Coloring, puzzle and activity book covers for 6-8. Loud, flat, cheerful.
kids_activity_bold.signature: bold flat vector cover illustration, thick even outlines, simple geometric shapes, flat solid fills of single colours, bright high-contrast children's activity book style
kids_activity_bold.light: flat even lighting, shapes evenly lit
kids_activity_bold.composition: one large hero subject filling the lower two thirds, facing the viewer, whole subject inside the frame
kids_activity_bold.background: a flat bright background colour with two or three large simple shapes
kids_activity_bold.negative: gradient, photorealistic, photo, muted, moody, dark, gritty, watermark, signature, extra limbs, blurry, text, lettering

kids_illustrated_scene.description: Illustrated non-fiction and picture-book covers for 6-8. Warmer, painted.
kids_illustrated_scene.signature: soft gouache cover illustration, visible brush texture, warm saturated palette, rounded friendly character design, classic children's picture book art
kids_illustrated_scene.light: warm golden afternoon light with gentle soft shadows
kids_illustrated_scene.composition: one hero subject in the lower half, clear silhouette against a simple sky
kids_illustrated_scene.background: a softly painted background with loose simple shapes and an open upper area
kids_illustrated_scene.negative: photorealistic, photo, 8k, ultra detailed, dark, gritty, watermark, signature, extra limbs, blurry, text, lettering

middle_grade_adventure.description: 9-12 non-fiction and activity covers. Dynamic, a bit cinematic, never cutesy.
middle_grade_adventure.signature: bold stylised illustration with clean shapes and strong silhouettes, rich saturated colour, dramatic simplified lighting, modern middle-grade book cover art
middle_grade_adventure.light: dramatic directional light with a strong rim highlight on the hero subject
middle_grade_adventure.composition: hero subject centred in the lower two thirds seen from a slightly low angle, strong readable silhouette
middle_grade_adventure.background: a simplified graphic environment with depth suggested by two or three flat layers
middle_grade_adventure.negative: photorealistic, photo, babyish, pastel nursery, chibi, watermark, signature, extra limbs, blurry, text, lettering

teen_graphic_bold.description: 13-17 covers. Design-led, confident, closer to adult non-fiction.
teen_graphic_bold.signature: bold graphic poster-style cover artwork, limited colour palette, strong geometric composition, high contrast shapes with generous negative space, contemporary editorial design
teen_graphic_bold.light: single hard light source producing clean graphic shadows
teen_graphic_bold.composition: one central symbolic object on a plain field, large empty area held clear for typography
teen_graphic_bold.background: a single flat field of colour with one subtle geometric texture
teen_graphic_bold.negative: cute, cartoon animal, nursery, pastel, photorealistic, photo, watermark, signature, blurry, text, lettering

adult_nonfiction_minimal.description: Adult non-fiction, productivity and journals. Type-led; the art is a supporting mark.
adult_nonfiction_minimal.signature: minimal editorial cover artwork, one simple symbolic shape, restrained two-tone palette, generous flat background, premium modern non-fiction design
adult_nonfiction_minimal.light: even soft light with the faintest shadow
adult_nonfiction_minimal.composition: one small symbolic mark centred low in the frame, the rest of the field deliberately empty
adult_nonfiction_minimal.background: a single flat background colour with subtle paper grain
adult_nonfiction_minimal.negative: cartoon, cute, childish, busy, cluttered, photorealistic, photo, watermark, signature, blurry, text, lettering

adult_puzzle_clean.description: Adult puzzle, sudoku, crossword and large-print covers. Legible, orderly, shelf-credible.
adult_puzzle_clean.signature: clean geometric cover artwork, orderly grid motif, crisp flat shapes, confident two-colour scheme, large-print friendly puzzle book design
adult_puzzle_clean.light: flat even lighting with crisp edges
adult_puzzle_clean.composition: a grid or pattern motif filling the lower half of the frame, the upper half held as a plain field
adult_puzzle_clean.background: a plain flat background with a subtle repeating geometric pattern
adult_puzzle_clean.negative: cartoon, childish, cute, photorealistic, photo, busy, watermark, signature, blurry, text, lettering

type_zones.top-third: the entire upper third of the image is a calm uncluttered area of plain flat colour
type_zones.top-half: the entire upper half of the image is a calm uncluttered area of plain flat colour
type_zones.bottom-third: the entire lower third of the image is a calm uncluttered area of plain flat colour
type_zones.center-band: a wide calm horizontal band across the middle of the image is plain flat colour

face_recipes.front: Hero art with the type zone held clear. This is the only face that has to work as a thumbnail.
face_recipes.back: A quiet extension of the same world at low contrast, so blurb text sits on it legibly. Fewer subjects, no focal point competing with the copy, and nothing in the barcode corner.
face_recipes.spine: Usually no generation at all: extend the front cover's background colour. Only generate spine art when the spine is wider than about 0.6 inches and the series is strong enough to carry a repeating motif.
